title: HIGGS low-density all-hidden fixed output-gain intervention
status_note: Bounded3arm source preparation and CPU checks only; no gain GPU qualification or learning result. Adaptive density choice after stock development curves is explicitly exploratory.

implementation_boundary.runtime: unchanged external public975 operators; no runtime or kernel copy
implementation_boundary.consumer: distinct fixed-output-gain architecture/feature calibration and eager loop based on depthf6; all trainable tensors stock/gain identical initially
implementation_boundary.optimizer: stock multi-site CSTAdamW, LR.0003, q1; fixed buffers outside optimizer
implementation_boundary.interpretation: forward-conditioning intervention changes effective amplitude range, gradient and regularization mapping; not pure initialization-only proof

calibration.partition: first256 new-training feature rows in original order
calibration.target: corresponding Dense initial square-linear-output RMS on the same features
calibration.algorithm: sequential public CPU-FP64 dense_weight composition; preceding gains applied before calibrating the next site
calibration.gain_storage: three nontrainable FP32 gains in one fixed vector buffer, fixed throughout optimization
calibration.infeasible: inconclusive; no training or automatic replacement target

protocol.selection: earliest minimum development CE within each arm
protocol.qualification: all3 arms normal elementwise Y/dX/all-grad plus field/packed-column norm and material coverage; 8step/4resume/finite/ownership/clocks before any learning
protocol.amplified_componentwise_role: diagnostic only; inherited failed stress remains failed, no arbitrary-cotangent per-component claim
protocol.training_metrics: online train CE/accuracy and separate full-train/development evaluation at the same checkpoint outside the training clock
protocol.scope: post-observation exploratory forward-conditioning intervention; changes effective amplitude bound, gradients and regularization mapping
protocol.adaptive_density_choice: Initially prepared alpha.001 without execution; changed before any gain GPU result to alpha.0001 after stock13 development curves showed all-D10000 stalled at AUC.5 while .001 and .01 learned. Exploratory targeting, not held-out confirmation.

evidence.availability: Ignored source preparation, earlier alpha.001 preparation snapshot, future feature-calibration/full raw artifacts and deployment receipts. No GPU result yet.
